requirements.title: Electives
requirements.summary: Choose two track electives from the department page; see the separately reviewed degree-guide conflict.

requirements.title: Host degree remains required
requirements.summary: Complete all BSCS degree requirements in addition to the local track. The Fall 2026 degree guide specifies 126 semester credits, 2.0 CS-major GPA and 2.0 cumulative GPA. This record does not enumerate or certify the entire BSCS.

requirements.title: Preserve BSCS breadth coverage
requirements.summary: Track courses occupy four BSCS elective slots. Students must still satisfy the host elective breadth areas A, B and C; one course may satisfy multiple breadth areas.

requirements.title: Combined programs
requirements.summary: The flyer permits the 4+1 pathway and completion at BS or MS level, and permits also pursuing the Cybersecurity track; it does not state that any particular course may overlap the two tracks.

requirements.title: Unresolved official elective discrepancy
requirements.summary: The September-updated department page and linked flyer include CS 417 and CS 481E. The June 2026 guide for Fall 2026 entrants omits CS 417 from its track list and refers instead to certain CS 480 offerings on the department website. The department pool is shown without treating this discrepancy as resolved.

hosting_unit: School of Computing, Thomas J. Watson College of Engineering and Applied Science
overview: An optional four-course AI track within the Computer Science BS, using two core courses and two electives. The host degree and its breadth rules remain required.
notes: Scope is the AI track, not a standalone BS award or a complete host-degree inventory.

Course names are corroborated by the official linked flyer; prerequisite statements for eleven courses come from the visually reviewed Fall 2026 guide, page 2. CS 417 and CS 481E prerequisites are unknown. The guide uses Intro/Introduction title variants for several courses; identities are matched by exact code.
Three credits for CS 481E are stated on the department page; semester normalization is supported by the current degree guide. All other credit amounts remain null.

The guide is printed 06/26; exact publication day is unknown. September 10, 2026 is the department page update, not the program launch date. Catalog-year label identifies the current Fall 2026 guide; the unversioned track page is separately dated.

Direct catalog returned HTTP 403 and dynamic widgets did not resolve in the public browser. Only public HTML widget code attributes and independently visible flyer/guide facts were used; no catalog restriction was bypassed.

Track declaration, track-specific grades, transfer/residency applicability, and the official elective discrepancy remain unresolved. General host-degree outcomes are not represented as track outcomes.
